main_defect_summary: R2 deep-dive of R1 silent-normalize chain produced two defects on POST /v1/schema. (1) Type2 submit-persist break: shardingConfig.desiredCount<0 (and virtualPerPhysical<0) returns HTTP 200 with an EMPTY body — no class echo, no error, no disclosure — yet the class is a phantom: GET /v1/schema/{class}->404, absent from schema list, POST properties->422 'class is nil: not found', GraphQL absent, until the first object write registers it. Controls prove validation exists (desiredCount=0->422 with explicit error) and negatives bypass it, while the response discloses nothing. (2) Type1 validation asymmetry on vectorIndexConfig ints: ef=-5/0, vectorCacheMaxObjects=-1, cleanupIntervalSeconds=-1, pq.centroids=-1 are accepted and persisted with HTTP 200 (echoed and read-back confirmed) while maxConnections=-1 and efConstruction=-5 are rejected 422 on the same config object — extends R1's gap map beyond the EF-anchor params to the active search-time param ef. R2 also answered the R1 open question: replicationConfig.factor normalization IS disclosed in the POST response (echoes 1, GET=1), so that path stays by-design-excluded.
